risk_summary: The excerpt presents a materially challenging operating environment, including prolonged school budget pressures, declining bond-funded projects, raw-material inflation, seasonal concentration, and limited pricing flexibility. Three consecutive years of operating losses and a valuation allowance against most deferred tax assets indicate elevated profitability and liquidity risk. Although the disclosure includes useful quantitative detail, extensive boilerplate risk disclaimers and forward-looking language reduce decisiveness.
